anomaly.blockedDriver: Windows blocked or flagged the driver {subject}.
anomaly.deviceProblemCode: A device has a driver error: {subject}.
anomaly.nonMicrosoftLsp: A non-Microsoft network filter is installed: {subject}.
anomaly.unknownFaultingModule: VALORANT crashed inside {subject}, which VTDiag doesn't know yet.
ask.fps_drops_over_time.text: Does FPS start fine and then drop the longer you play?
ask.friends_same_server.help: If many players have it at the same moment, it is usually a Riot server or internet provider problem.
ask.friends_same_server.text: Do your friends in the same region have the same problem right now?
ask.league_also_broken.help: If both Riot games fail the same way, the problem is usually Vanguard itself, not VALORANT.
ask.league_also_broken.text: Is League of Legends (or another Riot game) also broken on this PC?
ask.on_console.help: This tool checks Windows PCs. Console errors need Riot or the console maker.
ask.on_console.text: Are you playing on a console (PlayStation or Xbox)?
ask.on_wifi_or_cable.text: How is this PC connected to the internet?
ask.only_first_matches.text: Is it worst in the first match or two after an update, then gets better?
ask.only_valorant_affected.help: Think of another online game you play. Does it stutter or lag the same way?
ask.only_valorant_affected.text: Do other games run fine, and only VALORANT has this problem?
ask.other_account_works.help: Log out, log in with a friend's or a second account, and try once. If that account works, the problem is on the account side, not your PC.
ask.other_account_works.text: Does a different Riot account work on this same PC?
ask.others_cant_hear_me.text: Is the problem that teammates can't hear you (your microphone)?
ask.pc_built_recently.text: Is this a new PC, or did you recently change the motherboard, CPU or graphics card?
ask.secureboot_enable_broke_boot.text: Did your PC stop starting (or show a Secure Boot error) after you turned Secure Boot on?
ask.started_after_update.text: Did it start right after a Windows, driver or VALORANT update?
ask.stutter_periodic.help: A short freeze that comes back every 2 to 60 seconds, even when nothing is happening in the game.
ask.stutter_periodic.text: Does the stutter repeat on a rhythm, like every few seconds?
ask.uses_bluetooth_headset.text: Do you use a Bluetooth (wireless) headset for VALORANT?
ask.vanguard_precheck_on.help: Pre-Check is an option in the Vanguard tray icon menu (Windows 11 25H2 and newer). If you can't check it, choose 'Not sure'.
ask.vanguard_precheck_on.text: Did you turn on Vanguard Pre-Check (Vanguard only starts when you play)?
ask.whole_pc_freezes.text: Does the whole PC freeze (mouse stuck, music stops), not only the game?

code.van-0.meaning: Vanguard couldn't verify that the PC is ready to run the game or hit a problem while starting up.
code.van-1.meaning: Reported by players with dual boot or a broken Vanguard install (not on Riot's error list).
code.van-1067.meaning: Vanguard ran into an unexpected issue while starting or checking in with your system. Typically shows as a connection error asking to relaunch the client; can disconnect from a match. (Also the Windows system error number 1067 'The process terminated unexpectedly' - for the vgc service this is the same event.)
code.van-128.meaning: Vanguard couldn't complete one of its startup or system trust checks. (VAL list page: 'connection error'.)
code.van-133.meaning: Vanguard couldn't verify the PC is ready or hit an error while starting up (not a general connection error).
code.van-135.meaning: Vanguard couldn't verify the PC is ready or had an issue while initializing.
code.van-136.meaning: Reported with forced High/Realtime priority and high Vanguard CPU use (not on Riot's error list).
code.van-138.meaning: Game/Vanguard is running in a virtual machine or unsupported virtualized environment (not supported). Shows as 'Connection Error: VALORANT encountered a connection error. Please relaunch the client to reconnect.'
code.van-140.meaning: Startup or connection issue involving VALORANT, Riot Client and Vanguard; typical text is a connection error asking to relaunch the client.
code.van-148.meaning: Vanguard ran into an unexpected issue while starting or checking in with your system (client closes).
code.van-152.meaning: The device is restricted from playing due to a hardware ID (HWID) ban after a review found an account on this device violated User Rules (Section 7) of the Terms of Service. NOT a Vanguard install/connection problem. (VAL list page: typically lasts 4 months.)
code.van-184.meaning: Reported together with Memory Integrity requirements (not on Riot's error list).
code.van-185.meaning: Session or connection issue between the game, Riot Client and Vanguard.
code.van-193.meaning: Vanguard had trouble starting or communicating correctly with the Riot Client.
code.van-216.meaning: Reported with forced process priority (not on Riot's error list).
code.van-2266.meaning: Vanguard couldn't verify the PC is ready or had an issue while initializing.
code.van-25.meaning: Vanguard couldn't finish one of its startup or system trust checks. Client text: 'An unexpected error with Vanguard has occurred and the client will now close.'
code.van-289.meaning: Reported with VPNs and network filters (not on Riot's error list).
code.van-5.meaning: Reported by players with mid-match Vanguard disconnects (not on Riot's error list).
code.van-57.meaning: Usually means Vanguard isn't running or couldn't start correctly. Client text: 'An unexpected error with Vanguard has occurred and the client will now close.'
code.van-59.meaning: Usually means Vanguard ran into an unexpected issue while starting or communicating with the Riot Client (can close the client). NOT the same as VAL 59.
code.van-6.meaning: Vanguard couldn't verify the PC is ready to run the game or had an issue while initializing.
code.van-68.meaning: Vanguard lost the connection or session it needs while the game was launching or running.
code.van-84.meaning: Vanguard couldn't verify the PC is ready to run the game or errored while starting up.
code.van-9001.meaning: Vanguard doesn't detect TPM 2.0 as enabled. Text: 'This build of Vanguard requires TPM 2.0 to be enabled in order to play.'
code.van-9002.meaning: Vanguard can't find a required Windows security feature enabled: Windows Exploit Protection is disabled/altered.
code.van-9003.meaning: Secure Boot is not enabled. Text: 'This build of Vanguard requires secure boot to be enabled in order to play.'
code.van-9004.meaning: Vanguard requires 'Windows 10 20H1 or newer' but doesn't detect that version on the PC.
code.van-9005.meaning: Vanguard requires TPM 2.0 and UEFI-compliant firmware to use Virtualization-Based Security (VBS) but can't detect that security setup.
code.van-9006.meaning: Vanguard requires Windows 10 version 20H1 or newer and can't detect it; may also appear as 'VAN9006: This version of Vanguard requires Windows 20H1 or later and may not function as expected' (a warning in the Vanguard tray notification center).
code.van-9051.meaning: Vanguard hit an internal error it couldn't recover from ('encountered a critical error and cannot continue'); client closes so Vanguard can start fresh.
code.van-9090.meaning: Vanguard requires TPM 2.0 but the TPM 2.0 module did not initialize correctly.
code.van-9100.meaning: Vanguard detected the game running in a virtual machine or other unsupported virtualized environment.
code.van-9101.meaning: Attestation failure: Vanguard couldn't fully verify the PC's current system state.
code.van-incompatible-oem-driver.meaning: Vanguard detected a driver that doesn't meet its security requirements. Named cases: Intel VMD/RST (iastorvd.sys), third-party NVMe/SATA drivers (secnvme.sys, solidnvm.sys, asstahci64.sys), MediaTek RZ616 Wi-Fi 6E driver (mtkwl6ex.sys) older than 3.5.
code.van-incompatible-software.meaning: Vanguard found software or a driver that fails its security requirements ('Incompatible software component detected'); the error shows the offending file path (.sys).
code.van-iommu.meaning: Players' short name for the IOMMU restriction message.
code.van-m1.meaning: Usually means Vanguard was unable to start correctly or one of its required services is unavailable.
code.van-m101.meaning: Usually means Vanguard detected an unsupported system configuration (client closes).
code.van-m102.meaning: Usually means Vanguard is having trouble starting, staying connected, or confirming everything is ready during launch/gameplay.
code.van-m104.meaning: Usually means Vanguard is having trouble starting or staying connected while the game launches/runs.
code.van-m72.meaning: Vanguard having trouble starting, staying connected, or confirming it's ready while the game launches/runs.
code.van-m79.meaning: Vanguard having trouble starting, staying connected, or confirming it's ready; in-game text: 'VALORANT has encountered a connection error. Please relaunch the client to reconnect.'
code.van-m81.meaning: Usually means Vanguard is having trouble starting, staying connected, or confirming everything is ready while the game launches/runs. (VAL list page also describes -81 as 'service start failed'.)
code.van-m83.meaning: Usually means Vanguard is having trouble starting, staying connected, or confirming everything is ready during launch/play.
code.van-m92.meaning: Usually means Vanguard is having trouble starting, staying connected, or confirming everything is ready while the game launches/runs.
code.van-missing-m117.meaning: Usually means Riot Vanguard isn't running; the client closes automatically because Vanguard is required.
code.van-restriction-1.meaning: Vanguard couldn't verify that Secure Boot is enabled and working correctly.
code.van-restriction-3.meaning: Vanguard couldn't verify the game from the drive where it is installed.
code.van-restriction-4.meaning: Vanguard couldn't verify your PC's Secure Boot configuration (page title/error text: 'Secure Boot verification failure'). Verified by two fetches quoting the first paragraph.
code.van-restriction-5.meaning: Vanguard couldn't verify that Memory Integrity (HVCI/VBS, part of Windows Core Isolation) is enabled and running correctly.
code.van-restriction.meaning: Vanguard requires a Windows update or a Windows/BIOS security feature to be enabled before the game can launch; the error message itself names the requirement (Windows update, TPM 2.0, Secure Boot, Memory Integrity (HVCI/VBS), or IOMMU). Applies to the un-numbered variant only.
code.van-status-sb-policy.meaning: Vanguard could not verify the device's Secure Boot policy ('The secure boot policy on this device could not be verified.'). Can occur even when Secure Boot is ON.
code.van-status-vmd-9001.meaning: Vanguard detected a problem communicating with the Intel Volume Management Device (VMD) controller: 'The VMD controller has encountered a fatal unrecoverable error. Process will terminate.'

collector.conflict_defender_cfa_reg.desc: Registry setting used by Defender Controlled Folder Access
collector.conflict_defender_smart_app_co: Registry setting used by Windows 11 Smart App Control

collector.conflict_hags_reg.desc: Registry setting used by Hardware-accelerated GPU scheduling (HAGS)
collector.conflict_hvci_off_when_require: Registry setting used by Memory Integrity (HVCI) off or blocked by incompatible drivers when Vanguard requires it
collector.conflict_ipv6_binding_reg.desc: Registry setting used by IPv6 binding / Teredo on active adapter

collector.conflict_mpo_reg.desc: Registry setting used by Multi-Plane Overlay (MPO)
collector.conflict_required_services_dis: Registry setting used by Debloat scripts / tweakers that disable services Vanguard & Riot need (WinUtil, Chris Titus, O&O ShutUp10, privacy.sexy, batch 'optimizers')
collector.conflict_system_proxy_reg.desc: Registry setting used by System / WinHTTP proxy set
collector.conflict_tcp_tweakers_reg.desc: Registry setting used by TCP/registry network tweakers (TCP Optimizer, Leatrix Latency Fix)
collector.conflict_windows_insider_reg.d: Registry setting used by Windows Insider (Canary/Dev/Beta) builds
collector.conflict_xbox_game_bar_dvr_reg: Registry setting used by Xbox Game Bar / Game DVR background recording
collector.display_tdr.desc: Graphics driver stopped responding and recovered (Display 4101)
collector.realtek_nic_errors.desc: Realtek network driver errors and adapter resets
conflict.ac_battleye.effect.0: Kernel driver present alongside Vanguard (rare conflicts)
conflict.ac_battleye.fix: Usually coexists; only stop BEService if a conflict is observed.
conflict.ac_easyanticheat.effect.0: Usually coexists; shared stutter pattern with Realtek NIC issues
conflict.ac_esea.fix: Uninstall ESEA client when not used.
conflict.ac_faceit.effect.1: Requires SVM/VBS settings that change Valorant performance
conflict.ac_faceit.fix: Uninstall FACEIT AC (or stop its service and reboot) when playing VALORANT.
conflict.ac_mhyprot.effect.0: Known-vulnerable driver; can block HVCI / be flagged
conflict.ac_mhyprot.fix: Close the miHoYo game fully; uninstall if HVCI cannot be enabled.
conflict.ac_xigncode.effect.0: Listed as incompatible driver blocking Memory Integrity (HVCI)
conflict.ac_xigncode.fix: Uninstall the game using XIGNCODE3 / delete leftover xhunter1 service, then enable HVCI.
conflict.amd_adrenalin_features.effect.0: Stutter / FPS regressions on certain driver versions
conflict.amd_adrenalin_features.fix: Disable overlay, AFMF, RSR for VALORANT profile; roll back to a known-good driver with DDU if needed.
conflict.android_emulators.effect.0: Own hypervisor drivers / require VBS off: conflicts with HVCI requirement
conflict.android_emulators.fix: Close emulator; uninstall if HVCI must be on.
conflict.asus_armoury_crate.effect.1: RGB/fan service makes PC unstable in VALORANT
conflict.asus_armoury_crate.fix: Close Armoury Crate/LightingService; use Armoury Crate Uninstall Tool for full removal (G-Helper as laptop alternative).
conflict.asus_gpu_tweak.effect.0: OSD hook DLL unloaded/crashing; stutter after Oct 2026 update
conflict.asus_gpu_tweak.fix: Disable GPU Tweak OSD or exit GPU Tweak.
conflict.asus_screenxpert.effect.0: Oct 2026: stutter / loading-screen hang (Riot dev incompatible list)
conflict.asus_screenxpert.fix: Uninstall ScreenXpert (ASUS dual-screen laptops) or its wallpaper component.
conflict.audio_enhancers.fix: Disable enhancements for the device; uninstall if issue persists.
conflict.av_360.effect.0: Leftover network drivers break Riot Client (VAL 43)
conflict.av_360.fix: Uninstall 360 Total Security completely and reboot; check leftover filter drivers.
conflict.av_avast.effect.0: Quarantines/blocks Vanguard or Riot Client files
conflict.av_avast.fix: Add C:\Riot Games and C:\Program Files\Riot Vanguard (vgc.exe, vgk.sys) plus RiotClientServices.exe / VALORANT-Win64-Shipping.exe as exclusions; if still failing, uninstall with the vendor's removal tool and reboot (Defender takes over).
conflict.av_bitdefender.fix: Add C:\Riot Games and C:\Program Files\Riot Vanguard (vgc.exe, vgk.sys) plus RiotClientServices.exe / VALORANT-Win64-Shipping.exe as exclusions; if still failing, uninstall with the vendor's removal tool and reboot (Defender takes over).
conflict.av_kaspersky.fix: Add C:\Riot Games and C:\Program Files\Riot Vanguard (vgc.exe, vgk.sys) plus RiotClientServices.exe / VALORANT-Win64-Shipping.exe as exclusions; if still failing, uninstall with the vendor's removal tool and reboot (Defender takes over).
conflict.av_malwarebytes.effect.0: Exploit protection / ransomware module blocks Valorant (VAN 57 reported)
conflict.av_malwarebytes.fix: Add Riot folders to Malwarebytes Allow List or disable real-time Exploit Protection for VALORANT.
conflict.av_mcafee.effect.1: Preloaded trial expires but filter drivers stay
conflict.av_mcafee.fix: Add C:\Riot Games and C:\Program Files\Riot Vanguard (vgc.exe, vgk.sys) plus RiotClientServices.exe / VALORANT-Win64-Shipping.exe as exclusions; if still failing, uninstall with the vendor's removal tool and reboot (Defender takes over). Remove fully with McAfee Consumer Product Removal (MCPR) tool.
conflict.av_norton.effect.0: Smart Firewall blocks Riot Client / Vanguard traffic (VAN 185, VAL 5)
conflict.av_norton.fix: Add C:\Riot Games and C:\Program Files\Riot Vanguard (vgc.exe, vgk.sys) plus RiotClientServices.exe / VALORANT-Win64-Shipping.exe as exclusions; if still failing, uninstall with the vendor's removal tool and reboot (Defender takes over). Use Norton Remove and Reinstall tool for full removal.
conflict.av_other_suites.effect.0: Blocks Vanguard files / network (HIPS, firewall, auto-sandbox)
conflict.av_other_suites.fix: Add C:\Riot Games and C:\Program Files\Riot Vanguard (vgc.exe, vgk.sys) plus RiotClientServices.exe / VALORANT-Win64-Shipping.exe as exclusions; if still failing, uninstall with the vendor's removal tool and reboot (Defender takes over).
conflict.av_trend_micro.fix: Add C:\Riot Games and C:\Program Files\Riot Vanguard (vgc.exe, vgk.sys) plus RiotClientServices.exe / VALORANT-Win64-Shipping.exe as exclusions; if still failing, uninstall with the vendor's removal tool and reboot (Defender takes over).
conflict.bcd_tweaks.fix: Back up 'bcdedit /enum'; restore defaults (testsigning off, debug off, hypervisorlaunchtype auto, delete useplatformclock).
conflict.bluetooth_handsfree.effect.0: Voice chat switches BT headset to low-quality mono / no game audio after Nov 2025 patch
conflict.bluetooth_handsfree.fix: Disable 'Handsfree Telephony' service on the headset (Devices and Printers > Properties > Services) or use a separate mic.
conflict.bonjour_mdns.effect.0: Oct-Nov 2025: game stuck/not loading after patch, VAL 43; faulting module mdnsNSP.dll
conflict.bonjour_mdns.fix: Uninstall Bonjour (iTunes/Adobe bundle); no reboot needed.
conflict.cheat_engine.effect.0: VAN 79 after installing; IOMMU restriction; ban risk
conflict.cheat_engine.fix: Uninstall Cheat Engine and reboot (do not run with Vanguard).
conflict.cleaners_boosters.effect.0: Kill services in 'game mode', install wrong/old drivers, wipe Riot caches
conflict.corsair_icue.fix: Close iCUE / disable its hardware monitoring; update to latest.
conflict.dcontrol_defender_disabled.fix: Re-enable Defender via the tool / remove policy; leave AV on.
conflict.defender_cfa.effect.0: Riot Client/VALORANT cannot write config or install/update files (stuck update, settings not saved)
conflict.defender_cfa.fix: Add RiotClientServices.exe, VALORANT-Win64-Shipping.exe and the Riot installer to 'Allow an app through Controlled folder access' (keep CFA on).
VAN 185, VAL 29, VAL 43, VAN 84 (Riot Client / vgc cannot reach servers)
conflict.defender_firewall_block.fix: Ensure MpsSvc/BFE running; add allow rules for RiotClientServices.exe, VALORANT-Win64-Shipping.exe, vgc.exe; remove stale block rules.
conflict.defender_smart_app_control.effe: Blocks unsigned/low-reputation helper DLLs or installers (launch/installer failures)
conflict.defender_smart_app_control.fix: Report only; turning SAC off cannot be undone without resetting Windows, so ask the user explicitly.
conflict.discord_overlay.fix: Disable Discord in-game overlay and hardware acceleration.
conflict.dpi_bypass_windivert.effect.0: Packet-modifying kernel driver in the network path: possible Vanguard network errors / disconnects
conflict.dpi_bypass_windivert.fix: Stop/remove the GoodbyeDPI/zapret service and WinDivert driver service before playing.
conflict.elgato_capture.effect.0: Vanguard blocks DirectShow capture devices; capture card black/blocked
conflict.elgato_capture.fix: Use Elgato's recommended workaround (capture on another PC / updated software).
conflict.ene_rgb_driver.effect.0: 'Incompatible software component detected ... drivers\ene.sys' and game will not start (wave Jan-Feb 2026)
conflict.ene_rgb_driver.fix: Update/uninstall owning RGB app (Aura/Armoury Crate, RGB Fusion, MSI Mystic Light, Synapse 3, SignalRGB), then remove leftover ene service; renaming the .sys is last resort.
conflict.entech_se64a.effect.0: VAN: Incompatible software, game won't launch (Jan 2026; also League)
conflict.entech_se64a.fix: Uninstall the monitor-control utility that installed it.
conflict.exitlag.effect.0: Mostly used to fix ISP routing; can mask/alter routes (VAL 62 reports)
conflict.exitlag.fix: Disable while testing baseline ping; keep only if it fixes routing.
conflict.exploit_protection_override.eff: VAN 185 / VAN 79 / launch failures when CFG/ASLR forced off or on by tweaks (community-reported)
conflict.exploit_protection_override.fix: Back up with Get-ProcessMitigation -RegistryConfigFilePath; remove per-program overrides for Riot exes and reset system defaults.
conflict.fso_compat_flags.effect.0: Stutter / input lag; compat-mode flags break launch
conflict.fso_compat_flags.fix: Back up and remove stale compat flags for VALORANT/Riot exes; test FSO on/off.
conflict.gearup_booster.effect.0: Oct 2026: injected LSP DLL; stutter / loading hang (Riot dev incompatible list)
conflict.gearup_booster.fix: Uninstall GearUP Booster and verify C:\Windows\GearUPBooster LSP DLLs are gone.
conflict.gigabyte_gcc_rgbfusion.fix: Uninstall GCC/RGB Fusion; remove leftover gdrv service.
conflict.huawei_pc_manager.fix: Uninstall or disable performance monitor feature.
conflict.hvci_off_when_required.effect.2: Memory Integrity toggle reverts after reboot / 'incompatible drivers' list
conflict.hvci_off_when_required.fix: List incompatible drivers (Windows Security > Core isolation), remove/update their owning software, then enable Memory Integrity.
conflict.hyperv_hypervisor.effect.0: VAN 9100/138 'virtualized environment' when VALORANT itself runs in a VM
conflict.hyperv_hypervisor.effect.1: Turning hypervisor off breaks VBS/HVCI (VAN RESTRICTION)
conflict.hyperv_hypervisor.fix: Only remove Hyper-V role if not needed; keep hypervisorlaunchtype Auto when HVCI/VBS is required.
conflict.inpoutx64.fix: Uninstall the tool that installed it (fan/RGB/hardware utilities).
conflict.intel_nal_diag.effect.0: Incompatible software popup; known vulnerable driver
conflict.intel_nal_diag.fix: Uninstall Intel PROSet/diagnostic tool that loads it.
conflict.intel_vmd_rst.fix: Install Intel's updated VMD/RST driver for 12th-15th gen; restart.
conflict.ipv6_binding.effect.0: VAN 185 / VAN 84 / VAL 57 (community fix: prefer IPv4)
conflict.ipv6_binding.fix: Unbind IPv6 on active adapter (reversible) rather than DisabledComponents=0xFF.
conflict.killer_suite.fix: Disable prioritization/bandwidth control or uninstall the suite (keep base driver).
conflict.lenovo_vantage.effect.0: Wi-Fi throughput collapse while game runs
conflict.lenovo_vantage.fix: Disable network boost/updates in Vantage; keep for BIOS/driver updates.
conflict.logitech_ghub.fix: Exit G HUB while testing; onboard memory profiles keep settings.
conflict.mediatek_rz616.fix: Update to driver 3.5+ via Windows Update optional updates / Microsoft Update Catalog.
conflict.misc_flagged_drivers.effect.0: 'Incompatible software component detected' with path drivers\<name>.sys
conflict.misc_flagged_drivers.fix: Find owning software via driver service ImagePath/Publisher, uninstall it; DirectX64.sys is not a Microsoft file: scan for malware.
conflict.modified_windows.effect.0: Mitigations/VBS/Defender stripped: HVCI/TPM requirements fail, missing components (VAN errors, crashes)
conflict.modified_windows.fix: Report; revert AtlasOS toggles or reinstall stock Windows (destructive, user decision).
conflict.mpo.effect.0: Flicker, stutter after alt-tab, frame drops when enemies appear
conflict.mpo.fix: Set OverlayTestMode=5 (NVIDIA's MPO disable), reboot; delete value to undo.
conflict.msi_afterburner.effect.1: RTCore64.sys flagged as incompatible software component
conflict.msi_afterburner.fix: Close Afterburner + RTSS while playing; update to latest (old RTCore64 versions are vulnerable).
conflict.msi_center.effect.0: Bundled ene.sys / NTIOLib low-level drivers flagged
conflict.msi_center.effect.1: X3D Gaming Mode lobby freeze (MSI BIOS, disputed)
conflict.msi_center.fix: Update or uninstall MSI Center components (Mystic Light).
conflict.nahimic.effect.0: Sep-Oct 2026 wave: black screen / hang at launch, VALORANT stuck at tiny memory footprint
conflict.nahimic.fix: Stop + disable NahimicService first; if persists uninstall Nahimic (it may be reinstalled by OEM driver package/Windows Update).
conflict.ni_mdns.effect.0: Same as Bonjour: VAL 43 / not loading; faulting module nimdnsResponder.dll
conflict.ni_mdns.fix: Uninstall NI mDNS Responder / unused NI packages.
conflict.nielsen_meter.effect.0: Injected DLL shown in Event Viewer after Oct 2026 update; stutter
conflict.nvidia_overlay.effect.1: Overlay shows N/A for VALORANT after Oct 2026 update
conflict.nvidia_overlay.fix: Turn off in-game overlay / Instant Replay; keep driver.
conflict.nzxt_cam.fix: Exit CAM or disable its overlay.
conflict.obs_streamlabs.effect.0: Game-capture hook / encoder load: FPS drops
conflict.obs_streamlabs.fix: Use display capture or close while diagnosing.
conflict.omen_gaming_hub.effect.0: Crashes, VAN 185 with VALORANT in 'FPS boost'
conflict.omen_gaming_hub.fix: Disable OMEN overlay/boost for VALORANT or uninstall.
conflict.overwolf_trackers.effect.0: Memory leak / laggy menus after UI patches
conflict.overwolf_trackers.effect.2: Crash after game patch until app updates
conflict.overwolf_trackers.fix: Close all Overwolf processes or uninstall tracker apps.
conflict.premier_opinion.effect.0: Oct 2026: stutter / FPS drops / loading hang; pmls64.dll as faulting module (Riot dev incompatible list)
conflict.presonus_firestudio.effect.0: Listed as incompatible drivers preventing Memory Integrity
conflict.process_lasso.effect.0: High/Realtime priority or affinity on VALORANT/vgc: VAN 136/185, stutter
conflict.process_lasso.fix: Remove rules for VALORANT/vgc.exe; reset priority to Normal.
conflict.razer_synapse.fix: Update to Synapse 4 or uninstall Synapse 3; exit Cortex boosts.
conflict.realtek_2_5gbe.effect.0: Periodic micro-stutter/freezes every few seconds (vgc spikes) even when not in use
conflict.realtek_2_5gbe.fix: If playing on Wi-Fi: disable the Realtek adapter. On Ethernet: install latest Realtek driver, disable EEE/Green Ethernet/power saving.
conflict.realtek_gbe_family.effect.0: Same micro-stutter pattern; whole-PC freezes with rt640x64 NDIS resets
conflict.remote_desktop_tools.effect.0: Virtual display/input drivers; remote-control tools flagged (UltraViewer on Riot list)
conflict.required_services_disabled.effe: vgc not running: VAL 79 / VAN 79 / VAL 185
conflict.required_services_disabled.fix: Back up service config; restore default start types for listed services (vgc per Riot reinstall).
conflict.rtss.effect.0: Oct 2026 update: stuck on loading screen, huge FPS drops/stutter (Riot dev incompatible list)
conflict.rtss.fix: Exit RTSS (and Afterburner OSD) before launching; or add VALORANT to RTSS exclusions (Application detection level: None). Uninstall if it persists.
conflict.sandbox_rollback.effect.0: Vanguard install/update lost at reboot; driver filter conflicts
conflict.sandbox_rollback.fix: Run VALORANT outside sandbox; thaw system before Vanguard updates.
conflict.smartbyte_cfosspeed.effect.0: VAN 293 / packet shaping interferes with Riot traffic
conflict.sound_blaster_iommu.effect.0: Sound card disabled/killed when VALORANT launches (IOMMU/DMAr required)
conflict.sound_blaster_iommu.fix: Update Creative drivers; fall back to onboard/USB audio if card is not DMAr-compatible.
conflict.stardock.effect.0: Oct 2026: choppy game / loading-screen hang (Riot dev incompatible list)
conflict.stardock.fix: Exit or uninstall Stardock apps that hook explorer/DWM.
conflict.steelseries_gg.fix: Disable Sonar virtual devices / Moments; set real device as default.
conflict.storage_oem_drivers.effect.0: VAN: Incompatible OEM Driver (not DMAr compatible)
conflict.storage_oem_drivers.fix: Switch device to Microsoft 'NVM Express Controller' / 'Standard SATA AHCI Controller' (Device Manager > Update driver > pick from list).
conflict.system_proxy.effect.0: VAL 29 / Riot Client cannot connect (Riot lists proxy as cause)
conflict.system_proxy.fix: Back up and clear system proxy (and netsh winhttp reset proxy).
conflict.tcp_tweakers.fix: Restore defaults (TCP Optimizer 'Windows Default' or netsh int ip/winsock reset) after backup.
conflict.ultraviewer.effect.0: Listed on Riot dev Oct 2026 incompatible software list
conflict.usb_selective_suspend.fix: Disable USB selective suspend in active power plan (powercfg).
conflict.virtual_audio_mics.effect.0: Wrong default comms device, mic not heard
conflict.virtual_audio_mics.effect.1: Also used as workaround for the HFP voice-chat bug
conflict.virtual_audio_mics.fix: Check VALORANT voice input/output device mapping; set real devices as default.
conflict.virtualbox.fix: Disable host-only adapter; uninstall if unused.
conflict.vmware.effect.0: Virtual adapters / hypervisor drivers conflict; VM detection
conflict.vmware.fix: Disable VMnet adapters; stop VMware services while playing.
conflict.vpn_cloudflare_warp.effect.0: Used as a ping/routing fix but can trigger VAN 185 / VAL 29 / VAL 62
conflict.vpn_cloudflare_warp.fix: Disable WARP while playing; keep only if it measurably fixes routing.
conflict.vpn_corporate.fix: Disconnect and stop agent; work-managed PCs may not allow removal.
conflict.vpn_expressvpn.fix: Quit ExpressVPN and its service while playing.
conflict.vpn_generic.effect.0: VAN 185, VAL 43, VAL 62, VAN 84 (Riot: 'Using a proxy or VPN can result in various errors on Vanguard')
conflict.vpn_generic.fix: Fully exit VPN client (not just disconnect); disable leftover virtual adapters; uninstall if unused.
conflict.vpn_hamachi.fix: Stop Hamachi2Svc and disable its adapter.
conflict.vpn_mullvad_pia_windscribe.effe: VAN 185 / VAL errors while tunnel active
Free VPN browser proxies leave system proxy set
conflict.vpn_mullvad_pia_windscribe.fix: Quit client fully; uninstall if unused.
conflict.vpn_nordvpn.effect.0: VAN errors / disconnects while tunnel or adapter active
conflict.vpn_nordvpn.fix: Quit NordVPN fully, disable NordLynx adapter or uninstall.
conflict.vpn_openvpn_tap.effect.0: Leftover TAP adapter causes VAN 84 / VAN 185
conflict.vpn_openvpn_tap.fix: Disable or uninstall unused TAP adapters in Device Manager.
conflict.vpn_protonvpn.fix: Disconnect and quit Proton VPN; disable its adapter.
conflict.vpn_radmin.effect.0: Virtual LAN adapter conflicts (VAN 293 / connection errors)
conflict.vpn_radmin.fix: Disable Radmin VPN adapter or uninstall when not needed.
conflict.vpn_tailscale.fix: Disconnect Tailscale or disable exit node.
conflict.wallpaper_engine.effect.0: Stutter even when paused ('Unpause during Aero Peek')
conflict.wallpaper_engine.fix: Quit Wallpaper Engine while playing or disable 'Unpause during Aero Peek'.
conflict.windows_insider.effect.0: vgk.sys BSOD / Vanguard incompatibility on new builds
conflict.windows_insider.fix: Report; leave Insider and roll back to a release build (user decision).
conflict.winring0_tools.fix: Update to PawnIO-based versions or uninstall; stop the WinRing0 driver service.
conflict.wsl_vmp.effect.0: Virtual switch adapters; claimed VAN 1067/9100 links
conflict.wsl_vmp.fix: Report only; disable feature only if user doesn't use it.
conflict.xbox_game_bar_dvr.effect.0: Stutter / FPS drops from background capture
conflict.xbox_game_bar_dvr.fix: Back up keys; disable background recording (GameDVR_Enabled=0, AppCaptureEnabled=0).
drift.adapter_reenabled: The network port we turned off is on again (Windows Update or a driver install can do this).
drift.oem_reinstalled: The program we turned off came back (often after a Windows or manufacturer update).
drift.setting_reverted: A setting we changed went back to how it was (often after an update).
evidence.code.logged: Error {code} was found in the logs on this PC.
evidence.history.not_fixed: The fix '{fix}' was applied before but didn't help.
evidence.wave: Many players had this problem around this time.
fix.audio.bt_handsfree_off.explain: When VALORANT voice chat opens your Bluetooth headset's microphone, Windows switches the headset to Hands-Free mode, which sounds like an old phone call. We'll switch off Hands-Free mode, so game sound stays clear.
fix.audio.bt_handsfree_off.manual.0: Right-click the Start button and open "Device Manager".
fix.audio.bt_handsfree_off.manual.1: Open "Sound, video and game controllers" and find each Hands-Free device VTDiag named in your report.
fix.audio.bt_handsfree_off.manual.2: Right-click it and choose "Disable device", then click "Yes".
fix.audio.bt_handsfree_off.manual.3: Do the same for every Hands-Free entry in the report, then reconnect your headset.
fix.audio.bt_handsfree_off.manual.4: To undo, right-click the same device and choose "Enable device".
fix.audio.bt_handsfree_off.notice: Your headset's own microphone will not work over Bluetooth. Use a wired or USB microphone, or your laptop's microphone, for voice chat.
fix.audio.bt_handsfree_off.side.0: The Bluetooth headset microphone stops working until you undo this.
fix.audio.bt_handsfree_off.title: Stop your Bluetooth headset from switching to 'phone call' mode
fix.audio.bt_handsfree_off.undo: Press Undo and Hands-Free mode comes back.
fix.display.disable_fso.explain: Windows 'fullscreen optimizations' change how the game is shown on screen. For some players this causes stutter or alt-tab freezes. We'll switch them off for VALORANT only.
fix.display.disable_fso.manual.0: Close VALORANT and the Riot Client.
fix.display.disable_fso.manual.1: Open the folder of the VALORANT file VTDiag named in your report (VALORANT-Win64-Shipping.exe).
fix.display.disable_fso.manual.2: Right-click that file and choose "Properties", then open the "Compatibility" tab.
fix.display.disable_fso.manual.3: Tick "Disable fullscreen optimizations" and click "OK" (do not use "Change settings for all users").
fix.display.disable_fso.manual.4: Start VALORANT and play one match to check.
fix.display.disable_fso.title: Turn off fullscreen optimizations for VALORANT
fix.display.disable_fso.undo: Press Undo and the setting is removed.
fix.display.game_dvr_off.explain: Game Bar can record your gameplay in the background all the time. That recording costs FPS and can cause stutter. We'll switch off background recording (Game Bar itself stays).
fix.display.game_dvr_off.manual.0: Press Win+R, type "regedit" and press Enter to open Registry Editor.
fix.display.game_dvr_off.manual.1: Go to the key "HKEY_CURRENT_USER\System\GameConfigStore", right-click it and choose "Export" to save a backup.
fix.display.game_dvr_off.manual.2: Double-click "GameDVR_Enabled", set "Value data" to 0 and click "OK".
fix.display.game_dvr_off.manual.3: Go to "HKEY_CURRENT_USER\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\GameDVR" and export it as a backup too.
fix.display.game_dvr_off.manual.4: Double-click "AppCaptureEnabled" (or create it with New > DWORD (32-bit) Value), set it to 0 and click "OK".
fix.display.game_dvr_off.manual.5: Sign out and back in, then play one match; to undo, double-click your saved backup files.
fix.display.game_dvr_off.title: Turn off Xbox Game Bar background recording
fix.display.game_dvr_off.undo: Press Undo and background recording comes back.
fix.display.gpu_pref_high.explain: Your PC has two graphics chips, and Windows may run VALORANT on the weaker built-in one. We'll tell Windows to always use the strong graphics card for VALORANT.
fix.display.gpu_pref_high.manual.0: Open Settings > System > Display > Graphics (on Windows 10 the link is called "Graphics settings").
fix.display.gpu_pref_high.manual.1: Click "Browse" and pick the VALORANT file VTDiag named in your report, or click it if it is already in the list.
fix.display.gpu_pref_high.manual.4: Restart VALORANT so it starts on your graphics card.
fix.display.gpu_pref_high.title: Run VALORANT on your graphics card
fix.display.gpu_pref_high.undo: Press Undo and Windows chooses by itself again.
fix.display.hags_off.explain: Hardware-accelerated GPU scheduling (HAGS) is a Windows graphics option. With some drivers it causes stutter, input delay or freezes in VALORANT. We'll switch it off. It takes effect after a restart.
fix.display.hags_off.manual.1: On Windows 11, click "Change default graphics settings"; on Windows 10 the option is right on the "Graphics settings" page.
fix.display.hags_off.manual.3: Restart the PC, then play one match.
fix.display.hags_off.title: Turn off hardware-accelerated GPU scheduling
fix.display.hags_off.undo: Press Undo and restart to switch it back on.
fix.display.mpo_off.explain: Multi-Plane Overlay is a Windows display feature that some graphics drivers handle badly, causing flicker, alt-tab freezes or micro-stutter. We'll switch it off with the same setting NVIDIA recommends.
fix.display.mpo_off.manual.0: Press Win+R, type "regedit" and press Enter to open Registry Editor.
fix.display.mpo_off.manual.1: Go to the key "HKEY_LOCAL_MACHINE\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows\Dwm", right-click it and choose "Export" to save a backup.
fix.display.mpo_off.manual.2: Right-click the empty right side and choose New > DWORD (32-bit) Value, and name it "OverlayTestMode" (skip this if it already exists).
fix.display.mpo_off.manual.3: Double-click "OverlayTestMode", set "Value data" to 5 and click "OK".
fix.display.mpo_off.manual.4: Restart the PC; to undo, double-click your saved backup file and restart.
fix.display.mpo_off.title: Turn off Multi-Plane Overlay (MPO)
fix.display.mpo_off.undo: Press Undo and restart to switch it back on.
fix.generic.close_process.explain: This program is known to clash with VALORANT. We'll ask it to close (like clicking its X). It starts again next time you turn on your PC.
fix.generic.close_process.manual.0: Find the program VTDiag named in your report.
fix.generic.close_process.manual.1: Close its window with the X button.
fix.generic.close_process.manual.2: If it still runs near the clock, right-click its tray icon and choose "Exit" or "Quit".
fix.generic.close_process.manual.3: It will start again next time you turn on your PC, so repeat this before you play if needed.
fix.generic.close_process.title: Close this program for this session
fix.generic.close_process.undo: Nothing to undo: open the program again whenever you want.
fix.generic.disable_device.explain: This device or its driver is known to clash with VALORANT. We'll switch it off in Device Manager. Nothing is uninstalled.
fix.generic.disable_device.manual.0: Right-click the Start button and open "Device Manager".
fix.generic.disable_device.manual.1: Find the device VTDiag named in your report (open the group it belongs to).
fix.generic.disable_device.manual.2: Right-click it, choose "Disable device" and click "Yes" (do not choose "Uninstall device").
fix.generic.disable_device.manual.3: To undo, right-click the same device and choose "Enable device".
fix.generic.disable_device.title: Turn off this device
fix.generic.disable_device.undo: Press Undo and the device turns back on.
fix.generic.disable_startup_hkcu.explain: This program starts every time you sign in and can clash with VALORANT. We'll switch off its auto-start; it stays installed and you can still open it yourself.
Press Ctrl+Shift+Esc to open Task Manager.
On Windows 11 open "Startup apps"; on Windows 10 open the "Startup" tab.
Right-click the program VTDiag named in your report and choose "Disable".
Restart the PC; you can still open the program yourself when you need it.
fix.generic.disable_startup_hkcu.title: Stop this program from starting with Windows
fix.generic.disable_startup_hkcu.undo: Press Undo and it starts with Windows again.
fix.generic.disable_startup_hklm.explain: This program starts for every user when Windows starts and can clash with VALORANT. We'll switch off its auto-start; it stays installed.
Press Ctrl+Shift+Esc to open Task Manager.
On Windows 11 open "Startup apps"; on Windows 10 open the "Startup" tab.
Right-click the program VTDiag named in your report and choose "Disable" (say "Yes" if Windows asks for admin rights).
Restart the PC; the program stays installed and you can still open it yourself.
fix.generic.disable_startup_hklm.title: Stop this program from starting with Windows (all users)
fix.generic.disable_startup_hklm.undo: Press Undo and it starts with Windows again.
fix.generic.remove_compat_layer.explain: A program has old Windows compatibility settings (like 'run in Windows 8 mode'). These can stop VALORANT or the Riot Client from starting. We'll remove the listed settings.
fix.generic.remove_compat_layer.manual.0: Close VALORANT and the Riot Client.
fix.generic.remove_compat_layer.manual.1: Open the folder of the program file VTDiag named in your report.
fix.generic.remove_compat_layer.manual.2: Right-click the file, choose "Properties" and open the "Compatibility" tab.
fix.generic.remove_compat_layer.manual.3: Untick only the settings listed in your report (for example "Run this program in compatibility mode for").
fix.generic.remove_compat_layer.manual.4: Click "OK", then start the Riot Client again.
fix.generic.remove_compat_layer.title: Remove old compatibility settings from a program
fix.generic.remove_compat_layer.undo: Press Undo and the settings come back.
fix.generic.unbind_ipv6.explain: We'll switch IPv6 off on this one network adapter. Internet keeps working over IPv4.
fix.generic.unbind_ipv6.manual.0: Press Win+R, type "ncpa.cpl" and press Enter to open Network Connections.
fix.generic.unbind_ipv6.manual.1: Right-click the adapter VTDiag named in your report and choose "Properties".
fix.generic.unbind_ipv6.manual.3: To undo, tick the same box again.
fix.generic.unbind_ipv6.title: Turn off IPv6 on this adapter
fix.generic.unbind_ipv6.undo: Press Undo and IPv6 is switched back on.
fix.input.mouse_accel_off.explain: 'Enhance pointer precision' makes the cursor move further when you move the mouse fast. In a shooter that makes aim feel floaty and inconsistent. We'll switch it off.
fix.input.mouse_accel_off.manual.0: Press Win+R, type "main.cpl" and press Enter to open Mouse Properties.
fix.input.mouse_accel_off.manual.3: Restart the PC, then check your aim in the Range.
fix.input.mouse_accel_off.notice: Sign out and back in (or restart) for the change to apply everywhere.
fix.input.mouse_accel_off.title: Turn off mouse acceleration
fix.input.mouse_accel_off.undo: Press Undo and the old mouse setting comes back.
fix.net.disable_second_adapter.explain: Two network connections are active at the same time (for example cable and Wi-Fi). Windows can switch between them in the middle of a match, which causes lag and disconnects. We'll switch off the one you're not using.
fix.net.disable_second_adapter.manual.0: Right-click the Start button and open "Device Manager".
fix.net.disable_second_adapter.manual.1: Open "Network adapters" and find the adapter VTDiag named in your report.
fix.net.disable_second_adapter.manual.2: Right-click it, choose "Disable device" and click "Yes".
fix.net.disable_second_adapter.manual.3: Check that your internet still works; to undo, right-click it and choose "Enable device".
fix.net.disable_second_adapter.title: Turn off the second network connection
fix.net.disable_second_adapter.undo: Press Undo in VTDiag's undo list and the adapter turns back on.
fix.net.disable_unused_adapter.explain: Your PC has a wired Realtek network port that is switched on but not used. Its driver is known to cause short freezes every few seconds in VALORANT. We'll switch it off; your current connection keeps working.
fix.net.disable_unused_adapter.manual.0: Right-click the Start button and open "Device Manager".
fix.net.disable_unused_adapter.manual.1: Open "Network adapters" and find the Realtek adapter VTDiag named in your report.
fix.net.disable_unused_adapter.manual.2: Right-click it, choose "Disable device" and click "Yes".
fix.net.disable_unused_adapter.manual.3: Check that your internet still works; to undo, right-click it and choose "Enable device".
fix.net.disable_unused_adapter.notice: You stay on your current connection. If you plug in a cable into that port later, undo this first.
fix.net.disable_unused_adapter.title: Turn off the network port you're not using
fix.net.disable_unused_adapter.undo: Open VTDiag's undo list and press Undo. The port turns back on right away.
fix.net.dns_flush.explain: Windows keeps a list of internet addresses it looked up before. If an entry is old or wrong, Riot servers can't be reached. Clearing it is harmless; Windows rebuilds the list by itself.
fix.net.dns_flush.manual.0: Right-click the Start button and open "Terminal (Admin)" (on Windows 10: "Windows PowerShell (Admin)").
fix.net.dns_flush.manual.2: Wait for the message that the DNS cache was flushed, then start the Riot Client.
fix.net.dns_flush.title: Clear the DNS cache
fix.net.dns_flush.undo: There is nothing to undo: Windows refills the list automatically.
fix.net.realtek_power_saving_off.explain: Your network card has 'Energy Efficient Ethernet' or 'Green Ethernet' switched on. These power-saving features can make the connection pause for a split second. We'll switch them off.
Right-click the Start button and open "Device Manager".
Open "Network adapters", right-click the adapter VTDiag named in your report and choose "Properties".
Set each of these to "Disabled" if you see it: "Energy-Efficient Ethernet", "Green Ethernet", "Advanced EEE", "Gigabit Lite".
Click "OK"; your connection may drop for a few seconds and then come back.
fix.net.realtek_power_saving_off.notice: Your connection drops for a few seconds while the card restarts.
fix.net.realtek_power_saving_off.title: Turn off power saving on your network card
fix.net.realtek_power_saving_off.undo: Press Undo and the old power-saving settings come back.
fix.net.unbind_ipv6_active.explain: Some network cards (for example Killer) and some internet providers have trouble with IPv6, which can break voice chat or cause VAL 57 / 59 errors. We'll switch IPv6 off only on the connection you use. Normal internet keeps working over IPv4.
fix.net.unbind_ipv6_active.manual.0: Press Win+R, type "ncpa.cpl" and press Enter to open Network Connections.
fix.net.unbind_ipv6_active.manual.1: Right-click the connection you use (the one VTDiag named in your report) and choose "Properties".
fix.net.unbind_ipv6_active.manual.3: Play one match with voice chat; to undo, tick the same box again.
fix.net.unbind_ipv6_active.notice: Your connection drops for a moment.
fix.net.unbind_ipv6_active.title: Turn off IPv6 on your connection
fix.net.unbind_ipv6_active.undo: Press Undo and IPv6 is switched back on.
fix.net.winsock_reset.explain: Extra network filters from VPNs, boosters or old software can break how Windows talks to Riot. A Winsock reset puts the network settings back to factory state. This can't be undone with a click and needs a restart.
fix.net.winsock_reset.manual.0: Right-click the Start button and open "Terminal (Admin)" (on Windows 10: "Windows PowerShell (Admin)").
fix.net.winsock_reset.manual.1: Type "netsh winsock reset" and press Enter.
fix.net.winsock_reset.manual.2: Restart the PC when it says so.
fix.net.winsock_reset.manual.3: If a VPN or network tool stops working afterwards, reinstall it.
fix.net.winsock_reset.notice: You'll need to restart. VPN and network-booster apps may need to be reinstalled.
fix.net.winsock_reset.side.0: VPN or proxy programs may stop working until you reinstall them.
fix.net.winsock_reset.title: Reset the Windows network settings (Winsock)
fix.net.winsock_reset.undo: This can't be undone with one click. If something stops working, reinstall the VPN or network tool that needed the old settings.
fix.os.fast_startup_off.explain: With Fast Startup on, 'Shut down' doesn't fully restart Windows, so Vanguard can't load fresh and old boot files stay around. We'll switch Fast Startup off so every shutdown is a clean start.
fix.os.fast_startup_off.manual.0: Press Win+R, type "powercfg.cpl" and press Enter to open Power Options.
fix.os.fast_startup_off.manual.1: Click "Choose what the power buttons do" on the left.
fix.os.fast_startup_off.manual.2: Click "Change settings that are currently unavailable".
fix.os.fast_startup_off.manual.3: Untick "Turn on fast startup (recommended)" and click "Save changes".
fix.os.fast_startup_off.notice: Your PC may take a few seconds longer to start.
fix.os.fast_startup_off.title: Turn off Fast Startup
fix.os.fast_startup_off.undo: Press Undo and Fast Startup is switched back on.
fix.os.time_resync.explain: Your PC clock is off. A wrong clock breaks secure connections, so the Riot Client can't log in or Vanguard can't connect. We'll sync the clock with Microsoft's time server.
fix.os.time_resync.manual.0: Open Settings > Time & language > Date & time.
fix.os.time_resync.manual.1: Make sure "Set time automatically" is on, then click "Sync now".
fix.os.time_resync.manual.2: Or open "Terminal (Admin)" and type "w32tm /resync", then press Enter.
fix.os.time_resync.manual.3: Check that the clock is right, then start the Riot Client.
fix.os.time_resync.title: Fix your PC clock
fix.os.time_resync.undo: Undo doesn't set the clock back to the wrong time (that would break things again).
fix.power.cpu_max_100.explain: The 'maximum processor state' power setting is below 100%, so your processor never reaches full speed. We'll set it back to 100%.
fix.power.cpu_max_100.manual.0: Press Win+R, type "powercfg.cpl" and press Enter to open Power Options.
fix.power.cpu_max_100.manual.1: Next to the plan you use, click "Change plan settings", then "Change advanced power settings".
fix.power.cpu_max_100.manual.3: Set "Plugged in" (or "Setting" on desktops) to 100% and click "OK".
fix.power.cpu_max_100.title: Let the processor run at full speed
fix.power.cpu_max_100.undo: Press Undo and the old limit comes back.
fix.power.high_performance.explain: Your PC uses a power plan that saves energy by slowing the processor down. We'll switch to the High performance plan so VALORANT gets full speed.
fix.power.high_performance.manual.0: Right-click the Start button and open "Terminal (Admin)" (on Windows 10: "Windows PowerShell (Admin)").
fix.power.high_performance.manual.2: Press Win+R, type "powercfg.cpl" and check that "High performance" is now selected.
fix.power.high_performance.manual.3: To undo, pick your old plan in the same window.
fix.power.high_performance.notice: Your PC uses more power and laptops run warmer.
fix.power.high_performance.title: Switch to the High performance power plan
fix.power.high_performance.undo: Press Undo and your old power plan comes back.
fix.power.usb_selective_suspend_off.expl: Windows can put USB ports to sleep to save power. On some PCs this makes the mouse, keyboard or headset drop out for a moment, or freezes the whole PC. We'll switch that off.
fix.power.usb_selective_suspend_off.manu: Press Win+R, type "powercfg.cpl" and press Enter to open Power Options.
Next to the plan you use, click "Change plan settings", then "Change advanced power settings".
Set it to "Disabled" (both "On battery" and "Plugged in" if you see two) and click "OK".
fix.power.usb_selective_suspend_off.titl: Stop Windows from putting USB ports to sleep
fix.power.usb_selective_suspend_off.undo: Press Undo and the old power setting comes back.
fix.proc.close_overlays.explain: Overlay programs (like RivaTuner, Overwolf or clip recorders) hook into the game to draw on screen. After recent VALORANT updates, these hooks cause stutter, freezes and stuck loading. We'll close them for now; they'll start again next time you turn on your PC.
fix.proc.close_overlays.manual.0: Find each overlay or recording program VTDiag named in your report.
fix.proc.close_overlays.manual.1: Close its window with the X button.
fix.proc.close_overlays.manual.2: If it still runs near the clock, right-click its tray icon and choose "Exit" or "Quit".
fix.proc.close_overlays.manual.3: Start VALORANT and play one match; the programs start again next time you turn on your PC.
fix.proc.close_overlays.title: Close overlay and recording programs for this session
fix.proc.close_overlays.undo: Nothing to undo: open the programs again whenever you want.
fix.riot.client_runasadmin.explain: Many players fixed freezes and black screens after updates by running the Riot Client (RiotClientServices.exe) as administrator. We'll set that option on the Riot Client only, not on the game.
fix.riot.client_runasadmin.manual.0: Close VALORANT and the Riot Client.
fix.riot.client_runasadmin.manual.1: Open the folder of RiotClientServices.exe that VTDiag named in your report.
fix.riot.client_runasadmin.manual.2: Right-click RiotClientServices.exe, choose "Properties" and open the "Compatibility" tab.
fix.riot.client_runasadmin.manual.3: Tick "Run this program as an administrator" and click "OK" (do not use "Change settings for all users").
fix.riot.client_runasadmin.manual.4: Start the Riot Client again and say "Yes" when Windows asks.
fix.riot.client_runasadmin.notice: Windows will ask for permission (UAC) each time the Riot Client starts.
fix.riot.client_runasadmin.title: Always run the Riot Client as administrator
fix.riot.client_runasadmin.undo: Press Undo and the option is removed.
fix.sec.remove_riot_perfoptions.explain: VALORANT or Vanguard is forced to run at 'High' or 'Realtime' priority. That starves Vanguard and Windows and can cause VAN 136 / VAN 185 kicks. We'll remove the forced priority so Windows manages it normally.
fix.sec.remove_riot_perfoptions.manual.0: Press Win+R, type "regedit" and press Enter to open Registry Editor.
fix.sec.remove_riot_perfoptions.manual.1: Go to "HKEY_LOCAL_MACHINE\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows NT\CurrentVersion\Image File Execution Options\" plus the program name VTDiag named, then "PerfOptions".
fix.sec.remove_riot_perfoptions.manual.2: Right-click the "PerfOptions" key and choose "Export" to save a backup.
fix.sec.remove_riot_perfoptions.manual.3: In the right side, delete only the values "CpuPriorityClass" and "IoPriority" (keep the key itself).
fix.sec.remove_riot_perfoptions.manual.4: Do the same for each program in the report, then restart the PC.
fix.sec.remove_riot_perfoptions.title: Remove forced CPU priority from Riot programs
fix.sec.remove_riot_perfoptions.undo: Press Undo and the forced priority comes back.
fix.sec.reset_exploit_overrides.explain: Someone (or a tweak tool) turned off Windows Exploit Protection settings for Riot or Vanguard programs. Vanguard needs those protections and shows VAN 9002 without them. We'll remove the overrides so Windows defaults apply again.
fix.sec.reset_exploit_overrides.manual.0: Open Windows Security > App & browser control > Exploit protection settings.
fix.sec.reset_exploit_overrides.manual.2: Click the program VTDiag named in your report (for example vgc.exe) and click "Remove".
fix.sec.reset_exploit_overrides.manual.3: Do the same for each program in the report, then restart the PC.
fix.sec.reset_exploit_overrides.title: Remove Exploit Protection overrides from Riot programs
fix.sec.reset_exploit_overrides.undo: Press Undo and the old overrides come back.
fix.svc.disable_conflict_service.explain: A background program on your PC is known to clash with VALORANT or Vanguard. We'll stop it and keep it from starting with Windows. The program stays installed.
Press Win+R, type "services.msc" and press Enter to open Services.
Double-click the service VTDiag named in your report (check that "Service name" matches).
To undo, set "Startup type" back to what it was before.
fix.svc.disable_conflict_service.notice: The program's features (for example audio effects or RGB lighting) stop until you undo this.
fix.svc.disable_conflict_service.title: Turn off the program that clashes with VALORANT
fix.svc.disable_conflict_service.undo: Press Undo and the program starts with Windows again.
fix.vg.quarantine_bootstatus.explain: Vanguard keeps a small file (vgkbootstatus.dat) that remembers whether it started correctly. If that file is stuck, Vanguard keeps asking for a restart. We'll move it to VTDiag's quarantine folder. Then you restart.
fix.vg.quarantine_bootstatus.manual.0: Close VALORANT and the Riot Client, including its icon near the clock.
fix.vg.quarantine_bootstatus.manual.1: Make a new folder on your Desktop, for example "Vanguard backup".
fix.vg.quarantine_bootstatus.manual.2: Open the folder where VTDiag found vgkbootstatus.dat (the path is in your report).
fix.vg.quarantine_bootstatus.manual.3: Move the file into your Desktop folder with Cut and Paste, and click "Continue" if Windows asks (do not delete it).
fix.vg.quarantine_bootstatus.manual.4: Restart the PC, then start VALORANT.
fix.vg.quarantine_bootstatus.notice: You'll need to restart your PC (a real restart, not Shut down).
fix.vg.quarantine_bootstatus.title: Reset Vanguard's boot status file
fix.vg.quarantine_bootstatus.undo: Press Undo and the file is put back.
fix.vg.quarantine_stale_dat.explain: An old Vanguard boot file (392667600.dat) was left behind, which can cause blue screens or 'restart required' loops. We'll move it to VTDiag's safe quarantine folder (not delete it). Then you restart.
fix.vg.quarantine_stale_dat.manual.0: Close VALORANT and the Riot Client, including its icon near the clock.
fix.vg.quarantine_stale_dat.manual.1: Make a new folder on your Desktop, for example "Vanguard backup".
fix.vg.quarantine_stale_dat.manual.2: Open the folder where VTDiag found 392667600.dat (the path is in your report).
fix.vg.quarantine_stale_dat.manual.3: Move the file into your Desktop folder with Cut and Paste, and click "Continue" if Windows asks (do not delete it).
fix.vg.quarantine_stale_dat.manual.4: Restart the PC, then start VALORANT.
fix.vg.quarantine_stale_dat.notice: You'll need to restart your PC (a real restart, not Shut down).
fix.vg.quarantine_stale_dat.title: Move an old Vanguard boot file out of the way
fix.vg.quarantine_stale_dat.undo: Press Undo and the file is put back where it was.
fix.vg.vgc_automatic.explain: Vanguard's service (vgc) is set to start only when asked, and it isn't starting properly on your PC. Riot's own fix is to set it to start automatically. We only offer this because you told us Vanguard Pre-Check is off.
fix.vg.vgc_automatic.manual.0: Press Win+R, type "services.msc" and press Enter to open Services.
fix.vg.vgc_automatic.manual.4: Restart the PC, then start VALORANT.
fix.vg.vgc_automatic.notice: Restart your PC afterwards so Vanguard starts fresh.
fix.vg.vgc_automatic.title: Make Vanguard start with Windows
fix.vg.vgc_automatic.undo: Press Undo and the service goes back to its old start setting.
guard.adapter_is_active: This is the connection you are using right now, so we will not turn it off.
guard.no_internet: Your PC has no internet right now. Fix the connection first.
guard.no_other_connection: No other internet connection is working, so turning this off could cut your internet.
guard.pending_reboot: Windows is waiting for a restart. Restart first, then try again.
Go back to VTDiag's results and follow the top-ranked fix.
Sign back in with your own account when you're done testing.
The other account has the same problem, so the cause is on this PC (or your network), not your account.
Open a ticket with VTDiag's 'Contact Riot support' guide. Say clearly: 'Another account works on the same PC.' That saves a lot of back-and-forth.
Check your account at account.riotgames.com: email confirmed, the email for sign-in codes (MFA) correct, and no messages about restrictions.
VAL 43, VAL 57 or VAL 59 that only hit your account are often login or account-side. Wait 10-15 minutes, sign out fully and sign in again.
Another account works on this PC, so your PC is fine. The problem is on your account's side (a restriction, a login or MFA issue, or Riot-side data). VTDiag can't change that, but Riot support can.
guide.account.other_account.outcome: Do you know now whether it's the PC or the account?
guide.account.other_account.summary: Shows quickly whether the problem is your PC or your account. About 5 minutes.
guide.account.other_account.test.s1: In the Riot Client, click your profile icon > Sign out.
guide.account.other_account.test.s2: Sign in with a second account of your own, or let a friend sign in to their account on your PC. They type their own password; never share passwords.
guide.account.other_account.test.s3: Start VALORANT and try once, in the Range or a custom game.
guide.account.other_account.test.s4: Note what happens, sign out, and sign back in with your own account.
guide.account.other_account.test.s5: Answer VTDiag's question 'Does a different Riot account work on this PC?' so it can guide you further.
guide.account.other_account.test.text: If a different account works on this PC, your account is the problem. If it fails too, the PC is. The test takes about 5 minutes.
guide.account.other_account.title: Test with another Riot account
guide.apps.close_overlays.builtin.s1: Discord: User Settings (gear) > 'Game Overlay' (or 'Overlay') > turn off 'Enable in-game overlay'.
guide.apps.close_overlays.builtin.s2: NVIDIA app: open Settings and turn off 'NVIDIA Overlay'. (GeForce Experience: Settings > General > 'In-Game Overlay' off.)
guide.apps.close_overlays.builtin.s3: AMD Software: Settings (gear) > Preferences > turn off 'In-Game Overlay'. For VALORANT, also leave AFMF and RSR off.
guide.apps.close_overlays.builtin.s4: Xbox Game Bar: open Settings > Gaming > Xbox Game Bar and turn it off.
guide.apps.close_overlays.builtin.s5: Let VTDiag turn off Windows' background game recording (Game DVR).
guide.apps.close_overlays.builtin.text: Overlays built into Discord, graphics drivers and Windows.
guide.apps.close_overlays.bundled.s2: Uninstall 'Premier Opinion' (a market-research app that often comes bundled).
guide.apps.close_overlays.bundled.s3: Uninstall Nielsen panel or 'digital meter' software if you have it.
guide.apps.close_overlays.bundled.s4: ASUS dual-screen laptop? If you don't use 'ASUS ScreenXpert', uninstall it (or at least its wallpaper part).
guide.apps.close_overlays.bundled.s5: Huawei PC Manager: turn off its performance monitor, or uninstall it if you don't need it.
guide.apps.close_overlays.bundled.s6: Restart your PC and start VALORANT.
guide.apps.close_overlays.bundled.text: Some programs come bundled with other installs and hook into every game. Removing them is safe.
guide.apps.close_overlays.close_now.s1: Let VTDiag close overlay and recording programs for now. They start again next time you turn on your PC.
guide.apps.close_overlays.close_now.s2: Start VALORANT and play a match.
guide.apps.close_overlays.close_now.s3: Fixed? Then one of them was the cause, so turn their overlays off for good with the parts below.
guide.apps.close_overlays.close_now.text: First, find out if an overlay is the cause: close them all for this session.
guide.apps.close_overlays.outcome: Play one match. Is the stutter, freeze or loading problem gone?
guide.apps.close_overlays.rtss.s1: Right-click the RTSS icon next to the clock > Exit. Do the same for MSI Afterburner.
guide.apps.close_overlays.rtss.s2: Want to keep Afterburner for fan control? In its Settings > Monitoring, untick 'Show in On-Screen Display' for every item, so RTSS doesn't start.
guide.apps.close_overlays.rtss.s3: Or add VALORANT-Win64-Shipping.exe in RTSS and set 'Application detection level' to 'None'.
guide.apps.close_overlays.rtss.s4: For an FPS counter, use VALORANT's own: Settings > Video > Stats.
guide.apps.close_overlays.rtss.s5: Still having problems with it? Uninstall RTSS from Installed apps.
guide.apps.close_overlays.rtss.text: RivaTuner (RTSS) and MSI Afterburner's on-screen display are the most common cause.
guide.apps.close_overlays.summary: Programs that draw on top of the game (FPS counters, trackers, clip recorders, chat overlays) hook into VALORANT. After recent updates these hooks cause stutter, freezes and stuck loading. Close them first, then turn off the overlays you don't need. 5 to 15 minutes.
guide.apps.close_overlays.title: Close overlays and recording programs
guide.apps.close_overlays.trackers.s1: Overwolf: right-click its icon next to the clock > 'Exit Overwolf' before you play.
guide.apps.close_overlays.trackers.s2: Want to keep the tracker? In Overwolf's settings, turn off the in-game overlay for VALORANT; the tracker still works.
guide.apps.close_overlays.trackers.s3: Medal, SteelSeries Moments, Outplayed and similar: quit them from the icon next to the clock while you play.
guide.apps.close_overlays.trackers.s4: OBS or Streamlabs: use 'Display Capture' instead of 'Game Capture', or close it while testing.
guide.apps.close_overlays.trackers.s5: Wallpaper Engine: quit it while you play, or turn off 'Unpause during Aero Peek' in its settings.
If VAL 43 returns after you install something, check Installed apps for 'Bonjour' again.
Some installers have a tick box for Bonjour. Untick it when you see one.
iTunes, Adobe or printer installers can bring Bonjour back.
guide.apps.uninstall_bonjour.outcome: Start VALORANT. Does it get past the loading screen without VAL 43?
guide.apps.uninstall_bonjour.summary: Apple's Bonjour (comes with iTunes and some Adobe or printer software) and National Instruments' mDNS part load into VALORANT and can cause VAL 43 or a stuck loading screen. Removing them usually fixes it. About 15 minutes plus a restart.
guide.apps.uninstall_bonjour.title: Remove Bonjour or NI mDNS (VAL 43, stuck loading)
guide.apps.uninstall_bonjour.uninstall.s: Search 'Bonjour' and click '...' > Uninstall. If there are two (32-bit and 64-bit), remove both.
Search 'NI' and 'National Instruments'. If you don't need NI programs, uninstall 'NI mDNS Responder' and the other NI items.
Need LabVIEW or other NI software for school? Remove only 'NI mDNS Responder' and NI's updater; you can reinstall NI later.
iTunes and most Apple apps keep working without Bonjour; only some sharing features stop.
Restart your PC (Restart, not Shut down) and start VALORANT.
guide.apps.uninstall_bonjour.uninstall.t: Remove the programs that bring the mDNS part.
guide.apps.uninstall_bonjour.winsock.s1: Let VTDiag reset the Windows network settings (Winsock). This needs a restart and can't be undone with a click, but it's a standard Microsoft step.
guide.apps.uninstall_bonjour.winsock.s2: Restart your PC and start VALORANT.
guide.apps.uninstall_bonjour.winsock.s3: Still stuck? Reinstall Vanguard with the guide 'Reinstall Riot Vanguard' (guide.vanguard.reinstall).
guide.apps.uninstall_bonjour.winsock.s4: If nothing helps, contact Riot Player Support and attach the VTDiag report.
guide.apps.uninstall_bonjour.winsock.tex: If it still hangs, leftover network parts can stay in Windows. A Winsock reset clears them.
guide.apps.uninstall_conflict.gentle.s1: Let VTDiag stop the program's service and keep it from starting with Windows. It stays installed.
guide.apps.uninstall_conflict.gentle.s2: Restart your PC and start VALORANT.
guide.apps.uninstall_conflict.gentle.tex: Easiest first step: keep the program, but stop it running in the background.
guide.apps.uninstall_conflict.needed.s1: Open the program and look for 'Check for updates'.
guide.apps.uninstall_conflict.needed.s2: Or download the newest version from the maker's official site (Razer, Corsair, Logitech, ASUS, MSI and so on).
guide.apps.uninstall_conflict.needed.s3: Restart your PC and test VALORANT.
guide.apps.uninstall_conflict.needed.s4: Still clashing? Close it before you play (right-click its icon next to the clock > Exit); settings saved on the mouse or keyboard itself keep working.
guide.apps.uninstall_conflict.needed.tex: Do you need the program (RGB lights, mouse or keyboard software, fan control)? Then update it instead of removing it. Old versions cause most clashes.
guide.apps.uninstall_conflict.outcome: Restart your PC and start VALORANT. Is the problem gone?
guide.apps.uninstall_conflict.startup.s2: Turn the switch off next to the program.
guide.apps.uninstall_conflict.startup.s3: Restart your PC. Open the program yourself when you need it, and close it before you play.
guide.apps.uninstall_conflict.startup.te: Don't need it every time? Stop it starting with Windows and open it only when you need it.
guide.apps.uninstall_conflict.summary: The VTDiag report names a program known to clash with VALORANT or Vanguard. You can stop its service, update it, or uninstall it. 5 to 10 minutes.
guide.apps.uninstall_conflict.title: Remove or update a program that clashes with VALORANT
Search for the program name from the VTDiag report.
Click '...' > Uninstall and follow its steps.
Restart your PC (Restart, not Shut down) and start VALORANT.
Don't need it? Uninstall it. You can always install it again later.
If the hang comes back after an update, check Installed apps for Nahimic again.
Quickest: let VTDiag turn its service off again.
In MSI Center, don't install the Nahimic or audio-effects component.
Miss the effects? Your headset's own software or Windows' free 'Windows Sonic' spatial sound can do some of that.
Windows Update, MSI Center, Lenovo Vantage or Dell's tools can install Nahimic again later.
guide.apps.uninstall_nahimic.outcome: Start VALORANT. Does it get past the loading screen now?
guide.apps.uninstall_nahimic.service.s1: Let VTDiag stop the Nahimic service and keep it from starting with Windows. It stays installed.
guide.apps.uninstall_nahimic.service.tex: Start with the easy, undoable way: stop Nahimic's background service. Your sound keeps working, just without Nahimic's effects.
guide.apps.uninstall_nahimic.summary: Nahimic (A-Volute) is a sound-effects program that comes with many MSI, Lenovo, Dell and other PCs. It often gets into the game and causes a black screen or loading stuck at about 10%. Turning off its service fixes most cases. 5 to 15 minutes.
guide.apps.uninstall_nahimic.title: Turn off or remove Nahimic
guide.apps.uninstall_nahimic.uninstall.s: Search 'Nahimic' and 'A-Volute'. For each result click '...' > Uninstall.
Right-click the Start button and choose 'Device Manager'.
Open 'Software components' and find entries with 'A-Volute' or 'Nahimic' in the name.
Right-click each one > 'Uninstall device', tick 'Attempt to remove the driver for this device' and click Uninstall.
Also check 'Sound, video and game controllers' for a 'Nahimic mirroring device' and remove it the same way. Don't remove your normal audio device.
Restart your PC and start VALORANT.
guide.apps.uninstall_nahimic.uninstall.t: If VALORANT still hangs, remove Nahimic completely. Your sound works fine without it.
guide.audio.bt_handsfree.auto.s1: Let VTDiag stop your headset from switching to 'phone call' mode. You can undo it in VTDiag.
guide.audio.bt_handsfree.auto.s2: Turn the headset off and on again so it reconnects.
guide.audio.bt_handsfree.auto.s3: In VALORANT Settings > Audio > Voice Chat, set 'Output Device' to the headset's normal entry ('Headphones' or 'Stereo', not 'Hands-Free').
guide.audio.bt_handsfree.auto.s4: Set 'Input Device' to another mic (see 'other options' below), or turn voice chat off.
guide.audio.bt_handsfree.auto.text: VTDiag can switch off Hands-Free mode for you.
guide.audio.bt_handsfree.manual.s2: Click 'Devices', scroll down and click 'More devices and printer settings'. (Or Control Panel > Devices and Printers.)
guide.audio.bt_handsfree.manual.s5: Turn the headset off and on again.
guide.audio.bt_handsfree.manual.s6: If the headset shows up twice in the list, do the same for both.
guide.audio.bt_handsfree.manual.s7: To undo it, tick the box again.
guide.audio.bt_handsfree.manual.text: You can also do it by hand in a few clicks.
guide.audio.bt_handsfree.other_options.s: Use a separate mic: a wired or USB mic, the laptop's built-in mic or a webcam mic. Pick it as 'Input Device' in VALORANT Settings > Audio > Voice Chat.
Headset came with a USB dongle (2.4 GHz wireless)? Use the dongle instead of Bluetooth; the sound stays good with the mic on.
Connect the headset with its cable (3.5 mm or USB), if it has one.
Or turn voice chat off in VALORANT Settings > Audio > Voice Chat. Game sound stays clear.
Check Settings > System > Sound: 'Output' should be the headset's 'Headphones' or 'Stereo' entry, not 'Hands-Free'.
guide.audio.bt_handsfree.other_options.t: Bluetooth can't give you good sound and a mic at the same time. These ways keep the sound clear and still let you talk.
guide.audio.bt_handsfree.outcome: Join a match. Does your headset sound clear now?
guide.audio.bt_handsfree.summary: When VALORANT voice chat uses your Bluetooth headset's mic, Windows switches it to 'Hands-Free' mode and the sound gets muffled. Turning that mode off fixes the sound, but then the headset's mic won't work over Bluetooth. About 5 minutes.
guide.audio.bt_handsfree.title: Fix a Bluetooth headset that sounds like a phone call
guide.audio.output_device.devices.s2: Under 'Output', pick the headset or speakers you want. Under 'Input', pick your mic.
guide.audio.output_device.devices.s3: Start VALORANT, then open the 'Volume mixer' (on Windows 10: 'App volume and device preferences').
guide.audio.output_device.devices.s4: Find VALORANT. Set its output and input to 'Default' or to your headset, and make sure its volume isn't 0.
guide.audio.output_device.devices.s5: In VALORANT Settings > Audio > Voice Chat, check 'Output Device' and 'Input Device' too.
guide.audio.output_device.devices.s6: USB headset? Try a USB port on the back of the PC.
guide.audio.output_device.devices.text: First make sure Windows and VALORANT use the device you want.
guide.audio.output_device.driver.s1: Find your motherboard or laptop model in Settings > System > About.
guide.audio.output_device.driver.s2: Download the audio driver from that maker's support page (ASUS, MSI, Gigabyte, Lenovo, HP and so on). Don't use 'driver updater' programs.
guide.audio.output_device.driver.s3: Install it and restart your PC.
guide.audio.output_device.driver.s4: Did a new driver start the crackling? Try the version before it, which the maker's page often lists.
guide.audio.output_device.driver.s5: USB headset drops out for a moment? Let VTDiag stop Windows from putting USB ports to sleep.
guide.audio.output_device.driver.text: If sound crackles or drops everywhere, not just in VALORANT, the audio driver or USB power saving is the usual suspect.
guide.audio.output_device.exclusive.s1: Open Settings > System > Sound and click 'More sound settings' at the bottom.
guide.audio.output_device.exclusive.s2: On the 'Playback' tab, double-click your headset or speakers and open the 'Advanced' tab.
guide.audio.output_device.exclusive.s3: Untick 'Allow applications to take exclusive control of this device' and click Apply.
guide.audio.output_device.exclusive.s4: Do the same for your mic on the 'Recording' tab.
guide.audio.output_device.exclusive.text: Some programs take full control of the audio device ('exclusive mode'), so other programs go silent.
guide.audio.output_device.outcome: Start VALORANT. Is the sound coming from the right device, without crackling?
guide.audio.output_device.sound_apps.s1: Using ExitLag? Turn off its 'dual routing' option (sending traffic over two routes), which fixed broken voice chat for players.
guide.audio.output_device.sound_apps.s2: Using virtual audio (Voicemeeter, SteelSeries Sonar, NVIDIA Broadcast)? For a test, set your real headset as the default device in Windows and VALORANT.
guide.audio.output_device.sound_apps.s3: In Settings > System > Sound > your device, turn 'Audio enhancements' off for a test.
guide.audio.output_device.sound_apps.s4: Have Nahimic? See 'Turn off or remove Nahimic' (guide.apps.uninstall_nahimic).
guide.audio.output_device.sound_apps.tex: Sound programs and ping boosters can sit between the game and your headset.
guide.audio.output_device.summary: VALORANT may be sending sound to the wrong device, another program may be grabbing the device, or the audio driver may be the problem. About 10 minutes.
guide.audio.output_device.title: Fix no sound, the wrong device or crackling
guide.av.exclusions.cfa.s2: Go to 'Virus & threat protection' > 'Manage ransomware protection' > 'Allow an app through Controlled folder access'.
guide.av.exclusions.cfa.s3: Click 'Add an allowed app' > 'Browse all apps' and add C:\Riot Games\Riot Client\RiotClientServices.exe.
guide.av.exclusions.cfa.s4: Add the game file too: C:\Riot Games\VALORANT\live\ShooterGame\Binaries\Win64\VALORANT-Win64-Shipping.exe.
guide.av.exclusions.cfa.text: 'Controlled folder access' is on. It's a good protection, but it can stop Riot programs from saving files. Allow them and keep it on.
guide.av.exclusions.defender.s3: Look for entries that mention Riot, VALORANT, vgc or vgk.
guide.av.exclusions.defender.s4: Only for files inside the Riot Games or Riot Vanguard folders: open the entry > 'Actions' > 'Restore' or 'Allow'.
guide.av.exclusions.defender.s5: Keep Defender on. Turning it off is not a fix and leaves your PC unprotected.
guide.av.exclusions.defender.text: Check whether Microsoft Defender blocked a Riot file. It rarely does, but it's quick to check.
guide.av.exclusions.outcome: Restart your PC and start VALORANT. Does it start and stay connected now?
guide.av.exclusions.summary: Third-party antivirus programs sometimes block Vanguard or game files, which causes VAL 5, VAN 102 or lag. Add Riot's folders as exceptions; if that doesn't help, switch to the built-in Microsoft Defender. 10 to 20 minutes.
guide.av.exclusions.switch_to_defender.s: On a work or school PC, don't remove it. Ask the IT person.
Find your antivirus, click '...' > Uninstall and follow its steps.

If it doesn't fully go away, use the maker's free official removal tool from its own website (for example Norton Remove and Reinstall Tool, McAfee MCPR, Avast Clear, AVG Clear, Kaspersky kavremover, ESET Uninstaller).
Open Windows Security and check that 'Virus & threat protection' is on.
Paid for the antivirus? You can reinstall it later; your subscription stays on your account.
guide.av.exclusions.switch_to_defender.t: If exceptions don't help, remove the third-party antivirus. Windows' built-in Microsoft Defender turns on by itself and works fine with VALORANT.
guide.av.exclusions.third_party.s1: Open your antivirus (its icon is next to the clock).
guide.av.exclusions.third_party.s2: Find 'Exclusions', 'Exceptions' or 'Allowed list'. It's usually in Settings, under General or Protection.
guide.av.exclusions.third_party.s4: Add the folder C:\Program Files\Riot Vanguard.
guide.av.exclusions.third_party.s5: Add the game file C:\Riot Games\VALORANT\live\ShooterGame\Binaries\Win64\VALORANT-Win64-Shipping.exe (on another drive, change the letter).
guide.av.exclusions.third_party.s6: Check the antivirus 'Quarantine' or 'History' for blocked Riot or Vanguard files and restore them.
guide.av.exclusions.third_party.s7: Restart your PC and start VALORANT.
guide.av.exclusions.third_party.text: Add Riot's folders and the game file as exceptions in your antivirus.
guide.av.exclusions.title: Stop your antivirus from blocking Riot
guide.bcd.restore_security.general.s1: Open an admin Command Prompt: press Start, type cmd, right-click Command Prompt and choose Run as administrator. Click Yes.
guide.bcd.restore_security.general.s2: Paste this and press Enter. You should see 'The operation completed successfully.'
guide.bcd.restore_security.general.s3: Paste this one too. If Windows says the value is protected by Secure Boot policy, that's fine; just skip it.
guide.bcd.restore_security.general.s4: Paste this to turn off kernel debugging as well.
guide.bcd.restore_security.general.s5: Restart the PC: Start > Power > Restart (not Shut down).
